Metadata.Title: polish bro's mgs series 10
Metadata.Description: Greetings everyone, Polish bro here.Following the events of the previous operation, ICA has traced the surviving members of Golden Crescent to Santa Fortuna. Deep within the cartel-controlled jungle, the organization is making one last attempt to recover its remaining assets, erase every trace of its activities, and disappear for good.Your mission is to eliminate every target before they escape.This is the final chapter of Golden C. No survivors. No second chances.Good hunting, MFs.
